name: chart
title: Chart
description: shadcn-compatible Chart on Recharts in Material 3 Expressive: a big readout that follows one point in focus (hover, click or arrow keys), pill bars with goal badges, dotted zone and goal lines, a right-hand value axis, inverse tooltips, pill labels, donuts with a growing active slice, dotted radar grids, radial bars on tonal tracks, stage lanes and progress rings. Scatter charts get points ringed in the surface (chartPoint), a least-squares fit with its 95% band (chartLinearFit) and collision-free point labels (ChartPointLabels), for log axes, groups, standard curves, volcano plots and bubble dot plots. Every shadcn area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial and tooltip variant has a Material counterpart in the docs.
